name: pstack_sessions
obligation: Execute list, grep, current, and recall actions over the local session corpus.
Include the undocumented PI_SESSION_DIR variable for local workflow overrides when building the corpus directory list.
Explore up to 4 directories deep to locate .json and .jsonl files during the session file walk.
Filter results to include only files modified within the requested days cutoff.
Bypass the mtime cutoff and resolve the active session via ctx.sessionManager or PI_SESSION_FILE for the current action.
Return up to limit hits by joining 3 matching lines and truncating them to 400 characters for the grep action.
The recall action must merge local sessions, git log, and gh PRs into one ranked result using only local sources.
Rank hits using a base score of 20 for sessions, 18 for gh, and 15 for git.
Award additional score for exact substrings and per query token longer than two characters in the recall algorithm.
Break score ties by source priority and then by title.

name: pstack_deslop
obligation: Scan diffs for slop patterns and return severity-ranked fix suggestions.
Validate the scanner base ref parameter to reject leading dashes, dots, and whitespace, defaulting to main.
Include both the committed differences from base to HEAD and any unstaged working tree edits in the diff source.
Enforce exactly 19 slop rules categorized into high, medium, and low severities.
Delete only high-confidence safe comments like narration and empty lines when applySafe is enabled.
Override both applySafe and autoApply to simulate deletes without mutating files when dryRun is true.
Prompt for UI confirmation before performing safe deletions when autoApply is true.

name: /deslop
obligation: Queue a prompt string instructing the agent to run pstack_deslop and the unslop skill when /deslop is executed.

name: pstack_control_cli
obligation: Accept an argv array and validate its base command against the fixed 16-name executor allowlist, rejecting an unknown command and a dashed base.
Execute the CLI command without a shell and truncate output to 50000 characters.

name: pstack_control_ui
obligation: Probe an HTTP URL using the requested method and expected status without driving a real browser.
Return the HTTP response status and body snippet as the probe result.

name: pstack_benny_wake
obligation: Accept append, drain, or path actions to manage automation payloads.
Write a JSONL payload with timestamp and intent to the pstack-benny-wakes.jsonl file on append.
Return all pending payload lines and truncate the wake file to empty on drain.

name: /setup-benny
obligation: Instruct the agent to read and follow the setup-benny SKILL.md when /setup-benny is executed.

name: /benny-triage
obligation: Send the triage skill path for immediate evaluation when /benny-triage is executed.

name: /benny-repro
obligation: Send the repro skill path along with the provided issue context when /benny-repro is executed.
The benny pipeline must be drivable from the wake file by pstack_loop so a worker without an Automations host can enqueue work.
Cursor marketplace and .cursor-plugin manifest installs are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the content surface and local plugin discovery.
Cloud agent VMs and the remote cloud environment are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the worktree surface and isolated local worktrees.
The Automations Slack bus and direct message integrations are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the benny surface and its webhook receiver.
Grok Bot routines and built-in secret-request cards are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the benny surface.
First-party MCP clients and MCP capability inheritance to children are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the spawn surface.
Cursor sticky host semantics such as frontmatter mode, icon, color, and reminder are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the sticky surface.
Native /loop execution chrome and cadence management are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the loop surface.
Durable background jobs that survive process restarts are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the jobs surface.
Full Electron and IDE driving via control-ui is out of scope; the reproducible twin is the control surface.
The .mdc always-applied rules engine is out of scope; the reproducible twin is the models surface.
The cross-session Cursor transcript store and its lookup primitives are out of scope; the reproducible twin is the sessions surface.
Parent conversation-history inheritance to child agents is out of scope; the reproducible twin is the spawn surface.
Require the action parameter to be exactly list, grep, current, or recall.
Accept a query parameter for filtering results in grep and recall actions.
Constrain the limit parameter between 1 and 100 with a default of 20.
Constrain the days parameter between 1 and 365 with a default of 7.
Prioritize corpus directories in the order of the cwd .pi/sessions directory, the home agent sessions directory, the home sessions directory, and finally PI_SESSION_DIR.
Cap the session file walk at the 200 most recently modified files sorted by mtime.
Format the recall action output into four distinct sections for ranked merge, raw sessions, git log, and gh PRs.
Default the base parameter to main when not explicitly provided.
Accept a paths array parameter to restrict the scope of the diff scan.
Accept an applySafe boolean parameter to execute file mutations.
Accept an autoApply boolean parameter to trigger a UI confirmation prompt for file mutations.
Accept a dryRun boolean parameter to report mutations without writing files.
Cap the total number of suggestions returned by the diff scan at 80.
Limit the number of reported sample offending lines to 5 per slop rule.
Constrain the suggested fix blocks to a maximum of 25 lines.
Require the control_cli argv parameter to be an array with at least one element.
Accept an optional cwd parameter for the control_cli execution.
Constrain the control_cli timeoutSeconds parameter between 1 and 600 with a default of 120.
Require the url parameter for the control_ui HTTP probe.
Default the control_ui method parameter to GET.
Accept an optional expectStatus parameter for the control_ui probe.
Parse the payload string as JSON when possible and store it as a raw string otherwise.
Default the intent parameter to triage.
Locate the wake file explicitly under the Pi agent directory.
